Package rabdulwa_a1.ePortfolio

Class Stock

java.lang.Object
rabdulwa_a1.ePortfolio.Investment
rabdulwa_a1.ePortfolio.Stock
public class Stock extends Investment
Stock class is for investment in a stock. It Contains details about the stock symbol, name, price, quantity, and book value. It also contains methods to get and set the values of the different attributes of a stock investment.
